buddies.name: Ananya Mishra
buddies.bio: Born on the banks of the Ganges. I specialize in the spiritual history, hidden alleys, and ancient textile traditions of Kashi. Experience the city beyond the crowded tourist spots.

services.description: Early morning boat ride and walk through the oldest living alleys of the world

reviews_snapshot.comment: Ananya's knowledge of Varanasi's history is unmatched. A deeply moving experience.

buddies.name: Meera Rajput
buddies.bio: A local artisan passionate about Jaipur's vibrant crafts. Let me take you through the hidden bazaars, block-printing workshops, and architectural marvels of the Pink City.

services.description: Guided tour of Johari and Bapu Bazaar with a focus on authentic textiles and jewelry

reviews_snapshot.comment: Meera helped me find the most beautiful authentic fabrics and kept me away from tourist traps!

buddies.name: Kavita Singh
buddies.bio: Fascinated by Mewar history and architecture. I offer curated walks through the City Palace complex and hidden havelis surrounding Lake Pichola.

services.description: Deep dive into miniature paintings, local architecture, and royal history

reviews_snapshot.comment: Great insights into the palace architecture that we would have completely missed otherwise.

buddies.name: Riya D'Souza
buddies.bio: I explore the Goa beyond the parties. Join me for hidden cliff jumps, secret beaches, and authentic Goan fish thalis in local villages.

services.description: Half-day trek to secret coves and coastal viewpoints in North Goa

reviews_snapshot.comment: Riya took us to a beach where we were the only ones there. Truly magical!

buddies.name: Simran Kaur
buddies.bio: I know where to find the crispiest pani puri and the best vada pav in town. Let's eat our way through the bustling streets of Mumbai while capturing great photos.

services.description: Evening street food crawl covering Mohammed Ali Road or Juhu Chowpatty

reviews_snapshot.comment: The food tour with Simran was the highlight of our trip. Safe, delicious, and so much fun!

buddies.name: Lakshmi Menon
buddies.bio: Catching waves and chasing sunsets. I'll show you the best surf spots, quietest beaches, and the most authentic Kerala cafes along the Malabar coast.

services.description: Scooter tour along the coast, exploring hidden beaches and ending with a sunset viewpoint

reviews_snapshot.comment: Lakshmi is the coolest guide! She knows all the hidden cafes and beautiful empty beaches.

buddies.name: Aryan Sharma
buddies.bio: I see the world through my lens. Let me help you capture the true essence of Kashi—from the vibrant Sadhus to the peaceful morning Aarti—while showing you the best local tea stalls.

services.description: 3-hour guided photo walk covering the ghats and narrow alleys, including a mini-photoshoot

reviews_snapshot.comment: Aryan knows the exact spots for the perfect golden hour shots. Highly recommended!

buddies.name: Dr. Arvind Patel
buddies.bio: I have spent decades studying Mughal architecture. Skip the standard scripts and join me for a deep dive into the engineering and poetry etched into the walls of Agra.

services.description: Comprehensive 4-hour tour of the Taj Mahal and Agra Fort focusing on untold historical details

reviews_snapshot.comment: It was like walking through a living history book. Dr. Patel is an absolute treasure.

buddies.name: Tenzin Dorjee
buddies.bio: Born in the land of the rising sun. I specialize in high-altitude treks, monastery visits, and introducing travelers to authentic Monpa culture and cuisine.

services.description: Full-day exploration of Tawang Monastery and a guided hike to nearby high-altitude lakes

reviews_snapshot.comment: Tenzin kept us safe and showed us landscapes that took our breath away.

buddies.name: Bhawani Singh
buddies.bio: Welcome to the Blue City! I love showing off the indigo alleys, Mehrangarh Fort views, and capturing the vibrant colors of Rajasthan with my Nikon.

services.description: Early morning walk through the old blue alleys for the best light and uncrowded streets

reviews_snapshot.comment: Bhawani's eye for photos is amazing, and his stories about the city's history are captivating.

buddies.name: Tara Fernandez
buddies.bio: I document the vibrant street art and graffiti culture of Mumbai. Join me for a walk through Bandra's colorful alleys, where every wall tells a story of the city's underground art scene.

services.description: 2.5-hour walking tour of Bandra's iconic street art murals with photography tips.

reviews_snapshot.comment: Tara showed us a side of Mumbai we never would have found in guidebooks. Her energy is contagious!

buddies.name: Nidhi Shetty
buddies.bio: I left the corporate world to live by the sea. Let me take you on the famous Gokarna beach trek, show you hidden coves, and help you find the best coastal sunsets.

services.description: Guided 5-beach trek spanning from Paradise Beach to Kudle Beach.

reviews_snapshot.comment: Nidhi made the trek so much fun and knew exactly where to stop for the best views and cold drinks.

buddies.name: Aditi Rathore
buddies.bio: Udaipur isn't just about palaces; it's about the poetry of the lakes and the stories of the old city. Join me for golden hour walks along the ghats and royal tales.

services.description: Evening stroll covering the old city alleys, local markets, and a serene lakeside sunset.

reviews_snapshot.comment: Aditi's knowledge of Mewar history is fascinating. Watching the sunset with her stories was magical.

buddies.name: Naina Verma
buddies.bio: Between the French quarters and the Tamil streets lies a world of aesthetics, books, and incredible coffee. I'll take you on a photography and cafe-hopping adventure in Pondy.

services.description: Bicycle tour of the French Quarter followed by a curated cafe-hopping experience.

reviews_snapshot.comment: Naina knows the absolute best spots for coffee and croissants. A perfect relaxed afternoon!

buddies.name: Shreya Anand
buddies.bio: Finding peace by the Ganges. I guide travelers through mindfulness walks, introduce them to authentic ashram life, and host sunrise meditation sessions.

services.description: Early morning meditation by the river followed by a mindful walk and healthy sattvic breakfast.

reviews_snapshot.comment: Shreya's morning session was deeply grounding. Exactly what I came to Rishikesh for.

buddies.name: Rohan Joshi
buddies.bio: From the adrenaline of the Ganges rapids to serene mountain trails, I am your guy for all things adventure in Rishikesh. Let's explore the outdoors and capture some epic shots.

services.description: Guided trek to hidden waterfalls around Rishikesh with professional landscape and portrait photography.

reviews_snapshot.comment: Rohan is an amazing guide and took incredible photos of us by the waterfall. Highly recommend!

buddies.name: Kabir Singh
buddies.bio: I know every angle of the Hawa Mahal and the best times to avoid the crowds. Join me to explore the bustling bazaars, taste the best kachoris, and take stunning photos of the Pink City.

services.description: 3-hour morning photo walk covering Hawa Mahal exteriors, local flower markets, and street food stops.

reviews_snapshot.comment: Kabir showed us the best photo spots and took us to a place for the best lassi I've ever had.

buddies.name: Arjun Das
buddies.bio: Growing up among the rolling hills of Munnar, the tea gardens are my backyard. I offer guided hikes through the estates, wildlife spotting, and authentic tea-tasting sessions.

services.description: Half-day trek through private tea estates ending with a local tea tasting experience.

reviews_snapshot.comment: The hike through the tea gardens with Arjun was breathtaking. He is so knowledgeable about the local ecosystem.

buddies.name: Vikram Singh
buddies.bio: I wear my colorful turban with pride! From navigating the holy ghats of Pushkar to finding the best deals in the vibrant bazaars, I am your local desert companion.

services.description: Guided tour of the Pushkar bazaar, visiting hidden textile shops, followed by a sunset walk near the lake.

reviews_snapshot.comment: Vikram saved us a lot of money in the markets and explained the significance of the lake beautifully.
